tasks.title: Confirm eligibility, course matching and credit-transfer limits with the faculty
tasks.title_plain: 先确认自己符不符合资格、能不能转学分
tasks.action_plain: 对照外校的项目要求，确认自己的年级、专业和课程能不能对得上，需要转学分的话先问学院。
tasks.action: Check host factsheet requirements against the HKU curriculum and the faculty course list before applying
tasks.channel: HKUWW page + host factsheet + faculty office
tasks.deadline_raw: before the HKUWW Main Round application is prepared

evidence.quote: [申请前 FAQ](https://intlaffairs.hku.hk/backend/faqs/before-application/)要求先核对课程限制与学分匹配、及时提交语言证明，提交后不接受修改。

tasks.origin_note: Documents step 1 of the HKUWW pathway

tasks.title: Sit (or re-sit) the IELTS Academic test and keep the score valid until departure
tasks.title_plain: 重考雅思（现有成绩到出发时已经过期）
tasks.action_plain: 现有成绩在出发前就失效了，需要重新报名考试，并在申请前拿到成绩单。
tasks.action: Book an IELTS Academic test date, sit the test, and store the Test Report Form number
tasks.deadline_raw: score must exist before the application is submitted and must still be valid at departure

evidence.quote: Global 英语 IELTS 6.5、单项 ≥6，或 TOEFL 90 且 L22/W17/R21/S21；测试日期须 2025-01-08 或以后。
校内准备：100-word personal statement、英语能力证明；具体资格及外校更高 GPA／语言要求查上述官网和当年 factsheet

tasks.origin_note: Pre-existing score seeded from the student profile; the planner must notice it expires

tasks.title: Order the official HKU transcript
tasks.title_plain: 申请 HKU 正式成绩单
tasks.action_plain: 在 HKU Portal 里申请正式成绩单并缴费，一般需要约 10 个工作日。
tasks.action: Apply for an official transcript through HKU Portal SIS and pay the fee
tasks.channel: HKU Portal > SIS > Online Applications > Application for Transcript
tasks.deadline_raw: 10 working days normal processing, excluding weekends and public holidays

evidence.quote: 正常 10 工作日，不含周末及公众假期；新毕业生可能更久。保存申请摘要，Application Record 查状态

tasks.origin_note: Document lead time taken from the knowledge base section 2

tasks.title: Write the 100-word personal statement and the programme choices
tasks.title_plain: 写 100 字个人陈述、定下志愿顺序
tasks.action_plain: 写一段 100 字的申请理由，并把想去的学校排好先后顺序。
tasks.action: Draft the 100-word statement and finalise the ranked programme choices

evidence.quote: 校内准备：100-word personal statement、英语能力证明

tasks.title: Submit the HKUWW application in the Outgoing Application System
tasks.title_plain: 在 HKU 系统里提交交换申请
tasks.action_plain: 把成绩单、语言证明和个人陈述上传，在截止日期前提交（提交后不能修改）。
tasks.action: Upload the transcript, language evidence and statement, then submit the application
tasks.channel: HKUWW Outgoing Application System (goglobal.hku.hk) via HKU Portal login

evidence.quote: 提交后不接受修改

tasks.origin_note: Hard deadline: the only fully stated date in this pathway

tasks.title: Attend the HKUWW interview if invited
tasks.title_plain: 如果收到邀请，参加 HKU 的面试
tasks.action_plain: 部分申请人会收到面试邀请，收到后按邮件安排的时间参加（不是每个人都要面试）。
tasks.applies_if: the student receives an interview invitation (not every applicant is interviewed)
tasks.action: Prepare for and attend the selection interview

evidence.quote: Main Round 部分申请者于 2026 年 12 月下旬获面试邀请、2027 年 1 月中旬面试；**并非人人面试**。

tasks.title: Receive the HKUWW selection result
tasks.title_plain: 等 HKU 公布选拔结果
tasks.action_plain: 在申请系统里查看结果，并仔细阅读录取条件。
tasks.action: Check the result in the application system and read the offer conditions
tasks.origin_note: Waiting step: the student does not control the date

tasks.title: Accept the offer and pay the HK$2,000 deposit
tasks.title_plain: 接受录取并交 HK$2,000 押金
tasks.action_plain: 交押金、把付款证明和接受回执合成一个 PDF 上传，并在系统里点击接受。
tasks.action: Pay the deposit, merge the payment proof with the Letter of Acceptance Reply Slip into one PDF, upload and click Accept
tasks.channel: HKUWW application system + IAO payment instructions

evidence.quote: 单交押金不算完成接受；学院／学系名额走其指定渠道。

tasks.title: Receive the IAO nomination and follow the host instructions
tasks.title_plain: 等国际事务处确认提名，并按外校要求操作
tasks.action_plain: 收到提名确认后，登录外校的申请系统准备第二步申请。
tasks.action: Wait for the IAO nomination confirmation, then log in to the host application portal
tasks.deadline_raw: official window: nomination and host application in February-May 2027

evidence.quote: 接受后等待 IAO 确认提名，再按外校入口二次申请。官方概略窗口：S1／全年提名和外校申请为 2027 年 2–5 月

tasks.origin_note: Modelled as a prerequisite of the host application, so the two are never scheduled in parallel

tasks.title: Submit the host university application
tasks.action_plain: 按外校要求的清单提交材料（通常包括护照、成绩单、语言证明）。
tasks.action: Complete the host application with the documents the host lists, including passport and language evidence
tasks.channel: host application portal (link supplied after nomination)
tasks.deadline_raw: host deadlines are independent; the HKU registration deadline must not be substituted

evidence.quote: **提名不等于录取**；以外校确认收件／正式 offer 为准。

tasks.title: Receive the host admission and Letter of Acceptance
tasks.title_plain: 等外校录取通知和录取信
tasks.action_plain: 收到后接受录取，并下载 Letter of Acceptance 用于签证。
tasks.action: Accept the host offer and download the Letter of Acceptance
tasks.deadline_raw: host admission typically May-August for Semester 1

evidence.quote: 官方概略窗口：S1／全年提名和外校申请为 2027 年 2–5 月、录取 5–8 月

tasks.origin_note: Waiting step, but the Letter of Acceptance is a valid_until prerequisite of the visa

tasks.title: Apply for the UK student visa
tasks.action_plain: 准备好 CAS、资金证明和护照，在网上提交签证申请。
tasks.action: Prepare the CAS, financial evidence and passport, then submit the student visa application online
tasks.deadline_raw: decision normally within 3 weeks of the appointment

evidence.quote: 英国：签证线索见知识库第 6.6 节；审理时间与材料须查 GOV.UK 当前页面。

tasks.origin_note: Modelled conservatively: the planner does not give immigration advice, it only orders the step

tasks.title: Arrange accommodation, insurance and the HKU insurance record
tasks.action_plain: 申请外校宿舍、确认保险范围，并记下保单号码。
tasks.action: Apply for host accommodation, confirm insurance coverage and record the policy number

evidence.quote: 登记支持包含资助考虑、HKU group travel insurance 及同项目学生联系；实际保险保障须另核保单。

tasks.title: Book flights and complete pre-departure checks
tasks.action_plain: 拿到签证后再订机票，并按行前清单逐项确认。
tasks.action: Book travel after the visa is issued and run the pre-departure checklist
